title: TokenFriendsMFun
tagline: TokenFriends & MetalFun: Create, share, and track ERC20 tokens built for crypto newbies.
description:
- Seemlessly way to create erc20, 
- Send them to your friends (by eth address, username, phone (if linked))
- Receive them
- Explore and see how popular are them, comment, etc 
- Comfortable design oriented to new users
- Mobile oriented
- Future features:
    - Airdrops for people with a lot of activity in the platform
    - Mixing funds to obtain privacy regarding what we do with the tokens and which tokens we own
how_its_made:
Basically metal for all onchain behavior
- This allows to create users (holders)
- Create tokens
- Get all tokens and their holders
- Add liquidity to one sided univ4 pools
- And send them to friends
- The airdrop feature is still missing

Firebase + captcha for phone verification, 

React, express, and other common ts stuff for the web, replit to deploy and help on the initial frontend.

For mixing erc20s, new versions of tornado cash now deployed on base.
